annotations.title: Phone number validation: valid, E.164 format, country and line type

description: Validate and format a phone number with the libphonenumber rules: whether it is valid and possible, the E.164 form, international and national formatting, country, calling code and line type (mobile, fixed-line, toll-free, VoIP…). Give +country code, or a national number and a two-letter country. Offline: nothing is sent and it does not say the line is in service. Use to clean contact lists or check a number before an SMS. Example: number=+1 650-253-0000. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

country.description: Two-letter country for national numbers without +code (US, GB, SE…)
